pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pA higher-tier FE buffer and item charger. It keeps the same distinction between storage, cable throughput and item-charging throughput.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Supply power through a valid input or discharge slot.$p2. Place the target battery or tool in Charge.$p3. Set faces deliberately before attaching mixed EU/J/FE connections.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pThe external item can impose its own tier, direction, capacity or transfer limit even when the cube has room and power.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
